Storage.//: Durable blob storage. Provider 'filesystem' stores blobs on disk under Root, partitioned per tenant; switch to 'azure' with a real account connection string for the Azure deployment target. Set Root to a persistent, backed-up volume in production. Retention TTLs are the lifecycle policy the janitor enforces (screenshots and async run results shorter because they can carry PII); ResultTtl ages a stored async run result out of RunProgress. A TTL of 0 retains that category indefinitely.

DataProtection.//: Persists the ASP.NET Data Protection key ring so credentials registered via /browsers survive redeploys. BOTH set (the Azure deployment) => the key ring is stored in the KeyRingBlobUri blob and each key is wrapped by the KeyVaultKeyId Key Vault key, authenticated by the app's managed identity (set AZURE_CLIENT_ID for the user-assigned identity). BOTH empty (dev/test default) => the framework's default local key ring. Half-set fails fast at startup. The infra deploy feeds these via Crawldad__DataProtection__* env vars.

Webhooks.//: Durable webhook delivery for run-lifecycle events (issue #12). Delivery tuning only; the SSRF target policy (https + no loopback/link-local/private address) and the HMAC signature scheme are fixed in code. On a non-2xx or transport failure a delivery is retried with exponential backoff from BaseDelay (doubling, capped at MaxDelay) up to MaxAttempts total attempts, each bounded by Timeout; past the cap it is abandoned. Per-endpoint signing secrets are caller-supplied at PUT /webhooks/{name}, encrypted at rest, and never returned.

Billing.//: Stripe billing scaffolding (issue #119). Stripe.SecretKey + Stripe.WebhookSecret are BOTH required for billing to be 'configured'; absent (as here) the production gateway is a fail-closed stub (friendly 'not yet available', never a 500) and Development uses an in-process fake gateway. The Stripe .NET SDK is intentionally not a dependency yet — StripeBillingGateway documents where each call plugs in. Tiers is the tier catalog (moniker → display/price/included concurrent slots + the Stripe price id a subscription webhook maps back to a tier); omitted here so the code defaults from docs/BUSINESS_MODEL.md apply (Free 2 · Team $99/10 · Scale $499/50 · Enterprise custom). Override Tiers to set live Stripe price ids. PortalReturnUrl is the portal origin the hosted pages return to (empty → the fake gateway builds relative in-app result paths). Secrets are fed via Billing__Stripe__* env vars, never committed.
